headline.value: Due to continuous increase of water level of River Brahmaputra at Neamatighat in Jorhat district of Assam, Citizens are advised to stay away from the river. Issued in Public Interest by ASDMA.

description.value: River Brahmaputra at Neamatighat in Jorhat district of Assam continues to flow in above normal flood situation at 6:00 pm today. At 6:00 pm, it was flowing at a level of 84.79 m with falling trend which is 0.25 m above its Warning Level of 84.54 m and 0.75 m below its Danger Level of 85.54 m.
